culprit_citations.quoted_text: For the Three Months Ended March 31, 2026: Total investment income $51,941
Weighted average yield on total portfolio, at fair value: 9.1%

rationale: The source states that $51.941 million of total investment income covers the three months ended March 31, 2026, and reports total portfolio fair value of $2,153.908 million. Annualizing the source income gives 51.941 * 4 / 2153.908 = 9.6464%, consistent with the filing's independently reported 9.1% weighted average portfolio yield. The F27 ceiling is 11.1% using the filing yield plus 200 bps, so the source-grounded income yield passes. The 2.114 failing metric is therefore a bad check/anchor computation rather than a defect in the underlying fund financials.
